title: Center of Mass of Solid Uniform Right Circular Cone

variables.y_{\\text{cm}}: Distance of center of mass from flat base along central height axis

validity_conditions: Measured from base along symmetry axis toward vertex
common_misuse: Confusing solid cone (h/4 from base) with hollow cone (h/3 from base)
Measuring from apex (which is 3h/4) without adjusting
